title: Loss of control during an overtake
text: For this fictional exercise, a driver attempting an overtake must remain in reasonable control and take reasonable steps to avoid contact.

title: Substantially alongside
text: For this fictional exercise, when cars are substantially alongside, both drivers should provide reasonable racing room and maintain a predictable line.

title: Safe rejoining
text: For this fictional exercise, a driver who leaves the circuit may rejoin only when it is safe and without crossing unpredictably into the path of an approaching car.

title: Assessment of responsibility
text: For this fictional exercise, contact alone does not establish responsibility; position, control, predictability, available space and avoidability should be considered together.
